title: priv-vpc-eks-cluster-orchestration-terraform-kit
creator: Diego Ramos
description: Create a reusable, operator-friendly Terraform module and companion CI templates to reliably provision Redwood Private EKS control planes inside customer VPCs. This kit will be a drop-in replacement for ad-hoc bootstrappers and must encapsulate: idempotent network and subnet bindings, cross-account KMS integration for control-plane encryption, stable IAM roles for the controller plane, configurable nodegroup strategy, and preflight/health probes that feed into Redwood Console metrics. We will emphasize an operator-first pattern: generate a minimal, stable set of resources via Terraform and handover lifecycle operations (rolling upgrades, node remediations) to an in-cluster controller where appropriate. The module must be compatible with the existing priv-provisioner pipeline, support immutable canary upgrades, and include Terratest integration tests and Sentinel preflight checks for upgrades. Deliverables include Terraform module, example overlay for customer templates, a GitHub Actions pipeline, documentation in Confluence, and a runbook for failure modes and rollback procedures.
acceptance_criteria: Module exposes stable inputs for VPC/subnet IDs, KMS key ARNs, nodegroup sizing, and upgrade window policy
Terraform apply is idempotent across repeated runs in CI with zero drift for control plane resources
Automated preflight gating (Sentinel) prevents an upgrade if health checks or SLO projections fail
Health probes (control-plane and nodegroup readiness) are emitted to CloudWatch/Prometheus with documented metrics names
A demo private cluster can be provisioned and upgraded using the module with a canary workflow and automatic rollback on regression
Terratest suite passes in CI for create/destroy/upgrade scenarios and is run on each PR
tasks: Design module variable surface and default profiles (minimal, production, high-throughput)
Implement core Terraform module: networking attachments, IAM roles, EKS control-plane config, nodegroup blue/green setup
Add KMS cross-account key usage patterns and automated IAM bindings for rotation-safe upgrades
Implement preflight Sentinel policies and CI gating in GitHub Actions
Create Terratest integration suite and add to PR checks
Instrument health metrics and add exporters/CloudWatch dashboards for Console ingestion
Author Confluence design doc and public README with usage examples and migration notes
Draft runbook for upgrade rollback, control-plane restore, and emergency node replacement
